description: sdd-harness-web-ykryshtopa review gates: commit/merge/push guards, .claudeignore enforcement, typecheck-before-stop, session context banner

hooks.statusMessage: Checking staged diff for secrets, size, and protected-branch commits...
hooks.command: default=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@'); branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null); protected="${default:-main}"; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Detached HEAD: cannot verify this is not the protected branch, confirm before committing."}}'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$branch" = "$protected" ] || { [ -z "$default" ] && [ "$branch" = "master" ]; }; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Committing directly on %s requires confirmation."}}' "$branch"; exit 0; fi; diff=$(git diff --cached); stat=$(git diff --cached --shortstat); if [ -z "$diff" ]; then diff=$(git diff HEAD); stat=$(git diff HEAD --shortstat); fi; scan=$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | grep -vE 'process\.env|import\.meta\.env|os\.environ|ENV\['); if printf '%s' "$scan" | grep -qEi -- '-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|(secret|api)_?key[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*["'"'"']?[A-Za-z0-9/+_.-]{16,}|password[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]{8,}'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Staged diff matches a secret-like pattern (API key, private key block, or hardcoded password). Confirm before committing."}}'; exit 0; fi; ins=$(printf '%s' "$stat" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ insertion' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); del=$(printf '%s' "$stat" | grep -oE '[0-9]+ deletion' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); lines=$(( ${ins:-0} + ${del:-0} )); if [ "$lines" -gt 500 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Large commit (%s changed lines) - confirm this is intentional."}}' "$lines"; exit 0; fi; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'

default=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@'); branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null); protected="${default:-main}"; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Detached HEAD: cannot verify this is not the protected branch, confirm before merging."}}'; elif [ "$branch" = "$protected" ] || { [ -z "$default" ] && [ "$branch" = "master" ]; }; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Merging into %s requires confirmation."}}' "$branch"; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get("tool_input",{}).get("command") or "")'); elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){}process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||"")})'); else cmd=""; fi; default=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@'); branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null); protected="${default:-main}"; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Detached HEAD: cannot verify this is not the protected branch, confirm before pushing."}}'; elif [ "$branch" = "$protected" ] || { [ -z "$default" ] && [ "$branch" = "master" ]; }; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Pushing while on %s requires confirmation."}}' "$branch"; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '(^|[[:space:]])(--force([[:space:]=]|$)|--force-with-lease|-f([[:space:]]|$))'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Force-push requires confirmation."}}'; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -qF -- "$protected" || { [ -z "$default" ] && echo "$cmd" | grep -qF -- 'master'; }; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Push command references the protected branch by name; confirm target."}}'; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);ti=d.get("tool_input",{});print(ti.get("file_path") or ti.get("path") or "")'); elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then f=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){}const ti=j.tool_input||{};process.stdout.write(ti.file_path||ti.path||"")})'); else f=""; fi; if [ -z "$f" ] || [ ! -f .claudeignore ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; exit 0; fi; rel="$f"; case "$rel" in /*) rel="${rel#$PWD/}";; esac; while IFS= read -r pat; do pat=$(printf '%s' "$pat" | tr -d '\r'); case "$pat" in ''|'#'*) continue;; esac; case "$rel" in $pat|$pat/*|*/$pat|*/$pat/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by .claudeignore pattern: %s"}}' "$pat"; exit 0;; esac; done < .claudeignore; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'

[ -f tsconfig.json ] || exit 0; runCmd=''; tcScript=''; if [ -f .claude/harness.json ]; then if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(jq -r '[(.runCmd // ""), (.scripts.typecheck // "")] | @tsv' .claude/harness.json); elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(python3 -c 'import json;d=json.load(open(".claude/harness.json"));print(str(d.get("runCmd") or "")+chr(9)+str((d.get("scripts") or {}).get("typecheck") or ""))'); elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".claude/harness.json","utf8"));process.stdout.write((d.runCmd||"")+"\t"+((d.scripts&&d.scripts.typecheck)||""))'); else out=""; fi; runCmd=$(printf '%s' "$out" | cut -f1); tcScript=$(printf '%s' "$out" | cut -f2); fi; if [ -n "$runCmd" ] && [ -n "$tcScript" ]; then cmd="$runCmd $tcScript"; else cmd='npx tsc --noEmit --incremental'; fi; output=$($cmd 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$output" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '=== Branch ==='; git branch --show-current; echo '=== Git Status ==='; git status -s; echo '=== Recent commits ==='; git log --oneline -5; else echo 'Not a git repository.'; fi
